name: Ichimoku Cloud Trend Following - USDJPY
description: Daily Ichimoku Cloud trend-following strategy on USDJPY. Uses standard Ichimoku parameters (9/26/52). Long entry: Tenkan-sen crosses above Kijun-sen AND price is above the cloud. Short entry: Tenkan crosses below Kijun AND price is below the cloud AND Chikou span confirmation. Risk-unit sizing at 2% per trade with 2x ATR(14) stop distance. Trailing stop at 2x ATR(14).
source:
# Ichimoku Cloud Trend Following Strategy - USDJPY
# Standard parameters: Tenkan=9, Kijun=26, Senkou B=52
# Long: TK bullish cross + price above cloud
# Short: TK bearish cross + price below cloud + Chikou confirmation
# Risk: 2% per trade, 2x ATR(14) stop, trailing stop at 2x ATR(14)

# --- Data Source ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# --- Ichimoku Cloud (standard parameters) ---
ichi = ichimoku(p_tenkan=9, p_kijun=26, p_senkou_b=52)(src.h, src.l, src.c)
tenkan = ichi.tenkan
kijun = ichi.kijun
senkou_a = ichi.senkou_a
senkou_b = ichi.senkou_b

# --- ATR for stop distance ---
atr_val = atr(period=14)(src.h, src.l, src.c)
stop_dist = atr_val * 2

# --- TK Cross signals (pulses) ---
tk_bull_cross = crossover(tenkan, kijun)
tk_bear_cross = crossunder(tenkan, kijun)

# Persist TK cross state using hold_until
# Bullish state: from bullish cross until bearish cross
tk_bullish = hold_until()(enter=tk_bull_cross, exit=tk_bear_cross)
# Bearish state: from bearish cross until bullish cross
tk_bearish = hold_until()(enter=tk_bear_cross, exit=tk_bull_cross)

# --- Cloud filter (persistent conditions) ---
# Price above cloud: close above both Senkou Span A and Senkou Span B
above_cloud = (close > senkou_a) and (close > senkou_b)
# Price below cloud: close below both Senkou Span A and Senkou Span B
below_cloud = (close < senkou_a) and (close < senkou_b)

# --- Chikou Span confirmation (short side only) ---
# Chikou span = current close plotted 26 bars back
# Confirmation: current close < close from 26 bars ago
chikou_bearish = close < (close >> 26)

# --- Entry signals ---
# Long: TK bullish state AND price above cloud
long_entry = tk_bullish and above_cloud
# Short: TK bearish state AND price below cloud AND Chikou bearish confirmation
short_entry = tk_bearish and below_cloud and chikou_bearish

# --- Execution ---
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)

# Risk-unit sizing: 2% risk per trade, stop at 2x ATR(14)
# risk_unit bundles position sizing + stop loss
risk_unit(stop_unit=StopUnit.price)(risk_pct=2, stop_distance=stop_dist)

# Trailing stop at 2x ATR(14) - trails behind price as it moves favorably
trailing_stop()(distance=stop_dist)
